# Equations

## Dollar delimiters

Observe the signal at $t$ and act at $t+1$.

$$
r_t = \frac{C_t}{C_{t-1}} - 1
$$

## Backslash delimiters

The residual is \(\epsilon_t\).

\[
r_{BNB,t} = \alpha_t + \beta_t r_{H,t} + \epsilon_t
\]
